K-201 guaranteed curve with surge, stonewall, efficiency vs flow/head: If surge line is closer than 8.6% margin or stonewall below 213,712 m3/h, K-201 fails even with K-202 - would require different K-202 split or new K-201 wheel
K-202 vendor curve, surge line, rated flow/head, VFD range: If K-202 surge margin <10% or capacity <69 t/h at 1.81 pressure ratio, design limited below 120% - upsize to 75,000 kg/h

Anti-surge valve capacity and start-up dynamics for parallel operation: If anti-surge valve undersized or start-up trips K-201 on surge, design fails electrical/process - would require hot-gas bypass or sequential start logic

V-201 heater fouling state and achievable clean U: If clean U is 2,000 not 2,500, V-201 needs 9,794 vs 11,000 89% still passes today but margin shrinks to 11% - if fouled to 1,600 would need 12,243 vs 11,000 111% fail
